about_the_game:
FISH WITH FRIENDS WHILE YOUR WORK, WHILE YOU PLAY, WHILE YOUR CREATE...

Take to the Strange Shores of your desktop with up to three friends and fish while you go about your usual business. From a Farmer Frog and a collection of rubber duckies to ordinary lake fish like Perch, Pike and Trout, you and your pals can share in unusual and ultra-rare catches.

Game Features:

  • Resizable window that sits in the corner of your desktop  

  • 4 player online multiplayer 

  • Simple yet engaging fishing mechanics 

  • Over 100 fish or mysterious objects to catch 

  • Single-player fishing mode

  • Unlockable fishing locations

  • Cosy pixel-art style

FISH WITH FRIENDS

Fishing is better with friends. Host an online multiplayer session where you and up to three other friends can fish side-by-side, send emojis and share your catches. 

SHARE CATCHES

See one another’s catches in online multiplayer. Catches appear right above your friends’ heads. So you’ll know whether your fishing buddy has found a simple Bream or a rare Tilapia.

SEND EMOTES

React to one another’s catches by sending emotes. From a classic aubergine to a rubber ducky, let your pals know you’re thinking of them…or judging their rod-handling skills.

HOST A PRIVATE SERVER

Enjoy intimate private servers with your friends with Strange Shores’ simple server creation. Simply set your own server code, send it to your friends and then you’re ready to go.

SINGLEPLAYER MODE

We all need some alone time. Not to worry, you can play Strange Shores in single player mode, unbothered by other players. Catch the same fish, just with fewer distractions.

UNLOCK FISHING LOCATIONS

Fancy a change of scenery? From space to arctic icecaps, unlock new fishing locations by catching rare fish and unusual objects. The more you fish, the more locations you’ll unlock.

short_description: Strange Shores is a multiplayer fishing game you can play on your desktop. Catch over 100 fish and mysterious items, share your catches with friends, send emotes and unlock new fishing locations. Fish while you work, study, play, chat or create.
